title: A four-way Szegő theorem for $L^p$ extremal polynomials on subsets of $\mathbb R$
summary: We prove a four-way Szegő theorem for $L^p$ extremal polynomials on compact supports $K=K_0\cup X\subset\mathbb R$, where $K_0$ is a regular compact set and $X$ is a finite or countable set of isolated points. For every $2\le p\le\infty$, including the weighted Chebyshev case $p=\infty$ under the corresponding assumptions on the weight, any three of the Parreau--Widom condition for $K_0$, the Blaschke condition for $X$, the Szegő condition for the weight, and the Widom condition $0<\limsup_{n\rightarrow\infty}W_{p,n}<\infty$ imply the fourth.
